Does sampling year influence the results? 

Figure S7

## Libraries

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(easystats)
library(epitools) #calculation of binomial confidence intervals
source(here("code/000.tools/helpers.R"))
source(here("code/000.tools/plot.R"))
```


## Load main dataset

Input summary table for all genomes. 
```{r}
genome_summary_df <- read.table(here("data/processed/002.find_genes/pires1200_onlyblastcontigs_rmnonF-like_trantotraf/genome_tra_count_summary.tsv"),header = T,sep = '\t', quote = "")


genome_summary_df
```

Plots folder
```{r}
plots_folder <- here("data/processed/manuscript_plots/004.reg")

```


```{r}
#sampling year
genome_summary_df <- genome_summary_df %>% mutate("Sampling_Year" = if_else(Year < 2017,"Before 2017","After 2017")) %>% 
  mutate(Sampling_Year = factor(Sampling_Year,levels = c("Before 2017","After 2017")))

#add sample year category to summary table
#write.table(genome_summary_df,here("data/processed/002.find_genes/pires1200_onlyblastcontigs_rmnonF-like_trantotraf/genome_tra_count_summary.tsv"),sep = '\t',quote = F,row.names = F)
```


```{r}
associations_test("Sampling_Year","is.functional",genome_summary_df)
```


## Figure: functional completeness distribution across sample year in each animal environment

```{r}
p <- genome_summary_df %>% ggplot(aes(x = Sampling_Year)) + 
  geom_bar(aes(fill = functional_category)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Generic_Host),scales = "free") + 
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Sample Year",labels = c("Before\n2017","After\n2017")) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Number of genomes") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = functional_colours, name = "Functional completeness")  + 
  theme_manuscript +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
p
ggsave(paste0(plots_folder,"/","completeness_by_animal_sample_year.pdf"),p, units = "cm",height = 8, width = 16, dpi = 600)

```
